title: Urgency-weighted caption line
mechanism: For urgent work under visual constraints, use a single wrapping task caption with deadline first, duration second and a plain Details link; header/sections use the same ordered context line, with one glass navigation surface.

access: Use semantic buttons, 44px nonoverlapping targets, visible focus, keyboard disclosure, scope-specific names and focus return; disable scoped motion when requested.
benefit: One consistent caption replaces multiple competing shapes.

title: One summary sentence
mechanism: Use one short context sentence with deadline precedence and explicit empty-data rules; wrap without truncation. Limit the synopsis to consequential context; no truncated period labels.

title: Stable essential spine
mechanism: Retain the stable essential spine and inline definition lists; use object-specific accessible names, persistent selected period and inclusion state, separate completion targets, and existing Options menus with no hidden keyboard destinations. Keep completion separate and give every disclosure an object-specific name. Use object-specific accessible names and local definition lists. Retain every existing editor, action, link, diagnostic and scoped menu without duplicating command menus.

title: Dense action matrix

disclosed: Metadata Details row expands within matrix; mobile turns columns into stacked 44px controls; page/section menus retain all commands, diagnostic, links and recurrence editing.

title: Ledger with single material toolbar

title: Expandable dense columns
mechanism: For dense users, adversarially avoid a collapsed column silently losing data. Provide visible Columns disclosure with checked labels for date, duration, recurrence, price and time of day; only presentation changes.

disclosed: Unshown fields remain in task Details; header and section Summary retain all totals and breakdown; Options/inclusion/diagnostic routes are invariant across column configurations.

title: Baseline grid density
mechanism: For dense users, first principles derives compactness from shared baselines and spacing, not feature hiding. Header, section and task metadata use the same caption baseline with textual separators; visually grouped controls keep separate hit areas.

verification: Inspect hit-area overlap, dynamic numbers, price quantity, parallel time and long-label wrapping.

title: Visible commitment ribbon
